## Data and Methods

* CDR data source



```{r, cache = FALSE}
#| label: ant_ice
ant_ice <- CDR() |>
  cdo_monmean() |>
  cdo_setday(1) |>
  cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
  cdo_execute() |>
  ReadNetCDF("aice") |>
  setnames(c("xgrid", "ygrid"), c("x", "y")) |>
  _[, daice := c(diff(aice), NA), by = .(x, y)]
```

since 1983 because we found some problematic data before that. 

* ERA5 data source

```{r}
#| label: temp_era_mon
temp_era_mon <- ERA5_t2m() |>
  cdo_monmean() |>
  cdo_setday(1) |>
  cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
  cdo_execute() |>
  ReadNetCDF("t2m") |>
  setnames(c("xgrid", "ygrid"), c("x", "y"))
```

```{r, cache = FALSE}
#| label: daice
daice <- ant_ice |>
  _[year(time) > 1983] |>
  _[temp_era_mon[year(time) >= 1983], on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[year(time) < 2024] |>
  _[, t2m := t2m - 273.15] |>
  identity()
```


## Theory


```{r}
theory <- function(c, t) {
  alpha <- 1
  beta_f <- 1
  beta_m <- 3
  tf <- -1.8

  f <- alpha * (1 - c) * (t - tf)

  ifelse(f > 0, -beta_m * f * c, -beta_f * f * (1 - c))
}
```



```{r}
#| label: fig-theory-grid
#| fig-height: 5.35
#| fig-width: 8.24
CJ(aice = seq(0, 1, length.out = 40), t2m = seq(-15, 5, length.out = 40)) |>
  _[, theory := theory(aice, t2m)] |>
  ggplot(aes(aice, t2m)) +
  geom_contour_fill(aes(z = theory, fill = ..level..)) +
  geom_contour2(aes(z = theory)) +
  as.discretised_scale(scale_fill_gradient2)("dC/dt") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    "Monthly mean 2-m temperature (°C)",
    limits = c(NA, 2.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    "Monthly mean sea-ice concentration",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
cut_mid <- \(x, width, center) {
  breaks <- AnchorBreaks(center + width / 2, binwidth = width)(range(x))

  santoku::chop(x, breaks, labels = santoku::lbl_midpoints()) |>
    as.character() |>
    as.numeric()
}


grid_monthly <- daice |>
  _[year(time) > 1983] |>
  _[!is.na(daice)] |>
  _[,
    .(daice = mean(daice), n = sum(!is.na(daice))),
    by = .(
      t2m = cut_mid(t2m, 0.5, 0),
      aice = cut_mid(aice, 0.05, 0)
    )
  ]
```

```{r}
#| label: lm_constrained
lm_constrained <- function(data, formula) {
  # Design matrix for polynomial fit (example: quadratic in t2m, linear in aice)
  # formula <-
  X <- model.matrix(formula, data = data)

  y <- data$daice

  # Quadratic programming setup
  Dmat <- t(X) %*% X
  dvec <- t(X) %*% y

  # Constraints:
  # If aice=0 → fitted >= 0
  # If aice=1 → fitted <= 0
  # → These are linear in coefficients: X %*% beta >= 0 for rows with aice=0,
  #    X %*% beta <= 0 for rows with aice=1.

  A1 <- X[data$aice == 0, , drop = FALSE]
  b1 <- rep(0, nrow(A1))

  A2 <- -X[data$aice == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  b2 <- rep(0, nrow(A2))

  # negative values at high temp
  A3 <- -X[data$t2m > 0 & !(data$aice == 0), , drop = FALSE]
  b3 <- rep(0, nrow(A3))

  # positive values at low temp
  A4 <- X[data$t2m < -15 & !(data$aice == 1), , drop = FALSE]
  b4 <- rep(0, nrow(A4))

  Amat <- t(rbind(A1, A2, A3, A4)) # constraints in quadprog form: t(Amat) %*% beta >= bvec
  bvec <- c(b1, b2, b3, b4)

  fit <- quadprog::solve.QP(Dmat, dvec, Amat, bvec)

  # Create a normal lm fit and replace coefficients with the new
  formula2 <- as.formula(paste0("daice ~ ", as.character(formula)[2]))
  mod <- lm(formula2, data = data[1:100, ])
  mod$coefficients <- fit$solution
  mod
}
```

```{r}
#| label: model_monthly
n_samples <- 500000
model_monthly <- daice |>
  na.omit() |>
  _[year(time) < 2014]


# Make sure that we've got all the extreme low cases to ensure
# that the function is positive at those values.
temp_extreme <- -30
model_monthly <- rbind(
  model_monthly[t2m > temp_extreme][withr::with_seed(
    42,
    sample(.N, n_samples)
  )],
  model_monthly[t2m <= temp_extreme]
) |>
  lm_constrained(~ poly(t2m, aice, degree = 6, raw = TRUE))
```

```{r}
r2 <- daice |>
  na.omit() |>
  _[t2m > temp_extreme] |>
  _[sample(.N, n_samples)] |>
  _[, poly := predict(model_monthly, newdata = .SD)] |>
  _[, error := daice - poly] |>
  _[, .(var_obs = var(daice), var_error = var(error))] |>
  _[, 1 - var_error / var_obs]

```
